'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Adam Howland DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Adam Howland]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Username:''' MASTERJEDIADAM
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
